report: I received an email from what looked like the ICT department of Bayero University. The email said my student portal account would be suspended if I did not verify my details within 24 hours. There was a link in the email: http://bayero-student-portal.verify-now.xyz/login. When I clicked it, it took me to a page that looked exactly like the real portal. I entered my matric number and password before realising the URL was wrong. Please help.
